angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 605,955 km at 47.31 pc = 0.17 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 21.1363 +/- 0.0187 mas (same row, RUWE 0.81): 47.31 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.871 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Coy et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 3167 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract): 605,955 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.864 +/- 0.039 solar masses from Coy et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 3167 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5338 +/- 58 K from Coy et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 3167 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Coy et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 3167 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-3167.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.495, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 3167 (pscomppars): spectral type K0 V, from Christiansen et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..122C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 3167 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.037 dex, from Coy et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 3167 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.25727, from Coy et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 3167 (pscomppars): age 8.4 Gyr, from Coy et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026ApJ..1005L..77C/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 3167 (pscomppars): rotation period 23.52 d, from Gandolfi et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..123G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 3167 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.41 km/s, from Bourrier et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...654A.152B/abstract)
